title: Evidential Fusion Network for Multimodal Survival Prediction under Missing Modalities
abstract: arXiv:2606.20757v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent multimodal survival prediction models have demonstrated strong predictive performance by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, such models generally assume data completeness and exhibit limited robustness toward missing modalities, which are frequently encountered in real-world clinical settings. We propose the Evidential Missing Modality Survival Fusion (EMMS) model for multimodal survival prediction under missing modalities. EMMS offers a straightforward, computationally effective approach to survival analysis without requiring a generative phase for missing data. By employing Dempster-Shafer theory and Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers for multimodal decision fusion, it considers both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty alongside modality reliability for fusion. translated_title: 面向模态缺失场景的多模态生存预测证据融合网络
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态生存预测模型通过利用跨模态的互补信息，展现出了强大的预测性能。然而，此类模型通常假设数据是完整的，对模态缺失的鲁棒性有限，而模态缺失在真实临床场景中经常出现。我们提出了证据性缺失模态生存融合（EMMS）模型，用于模态缺失情况下的多模态生存预测。EMMS提供了一种简单直接、计算高效的方法来进行生存分析，无需对缺失数据进行生成式重建。该模型采用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态决策融合，在融合过程中同时考虑偶然不确定性与认知不确定性以及模态的可靠性。此外，该模型将缺失模态视为空证据，从而避免其对可用输入造成干扰，并自然地反映不完整数据的不确定性。
tldr: 提出了基于Dempster-Shafer理论的证据融合模型EMMS，无需生成式重建缺失数据，即可在模态缺失情况下实现鲁棒的多模态生存预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes EMMS, an evidential fusion model based on Dempster-Shafer theory that achieves robust multimodal survival prediction under missing modalities without requiring generative reconstruction of missing data.
